chapter_seo_title: The Lion Dance Chamber: Li Huowang Faces a Death Cult – Daoguai Yixian Ch. 234
chapter_meta_description: A grim discovery reveals a cult that worships death itself. Li Huowang faces a lion dancer from a cursed palace—a flat-faced horror with a body of hands.
og_title: The Lion Dance Palace’s True Face
og_description: When the lion’s head is replaced by a dead man’s face, the dance becomes a funeral. Li Huowang uncovers a religion that sacrifices the act of dying.
twitter_title: A lion dancer from a corrupted palace
twitter_description: Li Huowang uncovers a religion that doesn’t worship a god, but the act of death itself. The ritual’s performer is a horror of cloth, hands, and a flat human face.

lore_anchors.definition: A local institution in Qingqiu for teaching the art of the lion dance; its name suggests a formalized tradition that may conceal a secret, corrupted cult.
The city where the current events take place, likely part of the walled civilization inside the pass.
A foundational artifact of a suffering-cult that trades extreme agony for power; Li Huowang has embedded it under his own skin.
A grotesque, wriggling parasitic entity produced by corrupt cultivation; Li Huowang seeks it as an alchemical ingredient.
A detail in ritual logic; placing offerings backwards implies the recipient is not a deity above, but something below or internal.
A corrupted Daoist concept of transcendence achieved through rot and decay, inverting the traditional "Corpse Solution" myth.
